newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has upgraded its recommendation for Ericsson Telecomunicacoes, a unit of Swedish telecom giant Ericsson AB, to buy from hold.
-- The investment bank also said it raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings-per-share estimates as well as its year-end target price for the firm.
-- ING cited Ericsson's announcement of a 1.2 billion-real backlog in orders for the end of 1996, a 59 percent rise from the prior quarter.
-- It also cited signs the federal telecoms giant Telebras will adopt TDMA cellular technology in Sao Paulo state.
-- Ericsson is a major supplier of cellular and other telecoms equipment.
-- ING said it raised its 1997 EPS forecast for the firm to $4.96 from $3.70 and its 1998 estimate to $5.99 from $3.72. The estimates are for lots of 1,000 shares.
-- The bank also changed its year-end target price to $47 per 1,000 shares, "indicating a potential appreciation of 38.8 percent."
